subject: Peregrine RFI: control ownership matrix & collector onboarding
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@peregrine.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@peregrine.com
Date: 2027-08-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Peregrine RFI: initial ask and control list

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the RFI worksheet with the 180 controls we need mapped for our vendor review (pf_control_request_2027-08-18.xlsx). For the first pass we need:

- Control ownership (who at Redwood is the accountable owner)
- Evidence collector contact (email) for artifacts we may request
- Typical artifact name(s) and retention window

We'd like to run a short kickoff later this week to align on the collector process — our reviewers will pull artifacts directly from a shared bucket/drive once we validate collectors. Can you confirm:

1) Who will be the primary contact at Redwood for control ownership validation?
2) Whether you can onboard 1-2 evidence collectors to accept requests and upload artifacts to our drive?
3) Any blockers (NDAs, SSO access, export controls)?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Security Manager | Peregrine Financial
Attachment: pf_control_request_2027-08-18.xlsx (worksheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@peregrine.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine RFI: initial ask and control list

Elaine — thanks for the sheet. Quick answers below and a proposed lightweight process: 

1) Primary contact: Karthik Iyer (I will be the engagement lead). For per-control technical owners we will include folks from Security & Platform; I'll map those in the CSV and flag uncertain items.

2) Collector onboarding: yes — we can onboard two collectors (security-collectors@redwood.ai). Proposed roles: Neha will be the collector owner and Jordan will run the technical runbook.

3) Blockers: NDA first, then we can grant Drive access using short-lived SSO links. We will not export any keys or HSM artifacts to external buckets; we can provide redacted screenshots or CSP logs where applicable.

Proposed timeline (week of Aug 23):
- Aug 23: Deliver preliminary control ownership CSV (redwood_control_ownership_matrix.csv)
- Aug 24-26: Collector onboarding + test artifact exchange (collector-onboarding-runbook.pdf)
- Aug 30: First artifact delivery for 30 high-priority controls

Next steps: I will attach the initial ownership matrix tomorrow and loop Neha/Jordan for technical details. Does that timeline work for your review team?

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_control_ownership_matrix.csv (pending)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@peregrine.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine RFI: initial ask and control list

Hi Elaine / Karthik — looping in Jordan Blake (security eng) to own the collector runbook and technical onboarding.

Jordan: we'll need you to:
- Confirm what artifacts we can export vs. what must remain within Redwood's VPC (examples below).
- Provide a sample artifact package for SOC 2 log retention, access-review CSVs, and an ISO 27001 scope doc.
- Outline SSO onboarding steps (Okta SAML link + short-lived drive links).

Elaine — common artifact patterns we expect to deliver:
- access_review_YYYYMM.csv (de-identified user IDs)
- iam_policy_snapshot.json (redacted role ARNs)
- audit_log_bundle.tar.gz (compressed logs, 30-day window)

We will prepare the collector-onboarding-runbook.pdf with step-by-step instructions and a test checklist. Can you grant the redwood collectors a staging folder in the Drive link you plan to share? Also confirm whether your reviewers require native file timestamps preserved.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
CC: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@peregrine.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19T12:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine RFI: initial ask and control list

Thanks Neha — schedule looks good. We created a staging folder and sent a DocuSign NDA to the email listed for onboarding (procurement@peregrine.com is cc'd). DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/AB12C34DEF

A few clarifications from our reviewers:
- Prefer native timestamps where possible; if not, include file metadata in a manifest.csv
- For IAM artifacts, redaction of principal names is acceptable but we need role IDs and policy diffs
- For audit logs, we will accept a 30-day compressed bundle (gzip) with a SHA256 checksum

We'll plan a 30-minute kickoff on Aug 24 at 10:00 AM ET to validate the onboarding checklist. Can you send the runbook and the ownership matrix by EOD Aug 23?

Regards,
Elaine
Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@peregrine.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine RFI: initial ask and control list

Elaine — attaching the ownership matrix and the collector runbook per the timeline. High-level notes and action items below.

Attachments:
- redwood_control_ownership_matrix.csv (contains per-control owner, collector contact, typical artifact names, retention windows)
- collector-onboarding-runbook.pdf (technical steps, test checklist, SSO instructions)

Action items (Redwood):
- Karthik: engagement lead — coordinate reviewers, follow-up on any clarifications
- Neha: collector owner — complete onboarding checklist and confirm staging upload rights
- Jordan: run technical handoff and provide sample artifact bundles for the Aug 24 call

Action items (Peregrine):
- Elaine: confirm NDA completion (DocuSign) and share staging folder link prior to Aug 24 call
- Procurement: confirm PO or purchasing steps once initial artifact exchange validates scope

If you need a different time for the Aug 24 call, let me know. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood_control_ownership_matrix.csv, collector-onboarding-runbook.pdf
